$comment: The JSON members of MeshWeaver.Mesh.MeshNode (`members`) and the members it no longer has (`retired`). A node file carrying a retired member is a GATE ERROR (check-retired-node-fields.py, run on core's trees and in every node repo's validate lane), because GitSync's strict reader refuses the whole snapshot on it (#6638). MeshNodeFieldsRegisterTest keeps `members` equal to the type by reflection, so removing a member from MeshNode fails that test until its name moves into `retired` here. There is no tolerance: the content is migrated, never the reader.

retired.addressSegments: routing derives the address from the path prefix walk (Doc/Architecture/MeshGraph); remove the field
retired.instantiationType: instantiation is declared by the NodeType, not on the node; remove the field
retired.isPersistent: every node is persisted; remove the field
retired.isVirtual: virtual instances are served by the NodeType's prefix match; remove the field
retired.requires: package dependencies live in the package root's `content.requires`; remove the top-level copy
retired.routingType: routing derives from the path; remove the field
